text:
maria: Quick sync — ux review for API keys safety banner + revoke/create flow. Want opinions on ordering and copy before I push mocks.
aj: Putting the safety banner above the list makes sense, especially for orgs with lots of keys. Maybe collapsed by default? :thinking_face:
kevin: preference: banner expanded for first-time users, collapsed after. We can persist with localStorage or user setting.
olga: accessibility nit — if banner has important instructions about perms/revoke, it should be an ARIA alert (aria-live) so screen readers pick it up on page load.
sam: Also consider keyboard focus order: if banner is actionable (e.g., "Rotate all expired keys"), keyboard users should hit it before the table. Otherwise it's invisible to them.
aj: Good call. UX question: do we place the primary CTA in the banner "Create key" or keep Create in the top-right + a secondary action in the banner "Learn about rotation"?
maria: My sense: create stays top-right (consistent with other pages). Banner should be attention-first: "Review key safety" + onboarding CTA and a link to rotation policies. Primary in banner could be tertiary.
kevin: From dev side: if we add a CTA in the banner make it non-destructive and cheap — open a lightweight panel instead of modal. Heavy modals block keyboard flow.
olga: Copy proposals for the banner — short and clear, two lines. Option A: "Your API keys control access to your data. Rotate regularly and restrict scopes." Option B: "API keys are sensitive — limit permissions and rotate frequently. Learn how." Which is clearer?
aj: I prefer Option B (shorter). But tweak to avoid passive voice: "Treat API keys as secrets — limit permissions and rotate regularly."
sam: Also microcopy for revoke confirmation: current modal says: "Revoke key? This cannot be undone." That scares users. Suggest: "Revoke key — this will immediately invalidate the key. You can create a replacement or restore access via service principals." And include an undo snackbar for 30s with "Undo" action.
kevin: Implementing undo means we soft-revoke for 30s server-side. Feasible but needs product sign-off. Ops-bot: staged deploy for soft-revoke endpoints scheduled tonight.
ops-bot: deploy started: revocation-soft-delete-v2 -> staging (sha: b7c3fa).
maria: We should run a quick A/B: Group A sees the stronger warning + no undo, Group B sees softer wording + undo. Measure clicks to "Create replacement" and support tickets.
aj: Also propose small copy set for the key detail panel where the secret is shown once. Current: "Show secret" button. Proposed: "Reveal key (shown once)" and an inline help: "Copy it now — we can't show this secret again."
olga: For screen readers, when the secret appears we should call out via aria-live: "API key revealed. Press Ctrl+C to copy." And ensure the copy button gets focus after reveal.
sam: Empty state idea: when no keys, show two columns: left with big CTA "Create API key", right with short checklist (1) Use least privileges, (2) Rotate every 90 days, (3) Use dedicated bundles for services. Include a sample permission config snippet.
kevin: sample snippet (for the checklist) — paste below:

```json
{
  "name": "service-worker",
  "scopes": ["embeddings:read", "models:infer"],
  "expires_in_days": 90
}
```

aj: Love the checklist. Visual affordance wise: give the CTA a subtle outline primary instead of solid to avoid competing with global primary actions.
maria: Quick decision items: 1) Banner expanded for new orgs, collapsed for returning. 2) Banner copy: use aj's revised Option B. 3) Revoke modal: softer wording + undo snackbar (requires engineering sign-off). 4) Create key reveal: change microcopy and add aria-live + focus. 5) Empty state: checklist + sample snippet.
kevin: I can slot the soft-revoke work in next sprint if product confirms. Will need an API flag for soft-delete.
aj: I'll update mocks and include two microcopy variants for the A/B test. Pinging @maria for approval on copy so I can hand to design system.
maria: Approved for mocks. Thanks all — please leave any last nits here before EOD.
kevin: tiny nit — ensure we don't leak full key in console logs when copying. Use masked value in DOM until reveal.
olga: Also verify color contrast on banner CTA (AA). I'll run a quick check once mocks are up.
sam: thanks — I'll add a tracking event for "key_revealed" and "key_revoked" with method metadata.
aj: cool, I'll push updated Figma links soon. :thumbsup:
